# finflow-frontend

> Next.js 15 (App Router) + Supabase PWA for the FinFlow personal finance app.
> Client pages fetch via Supabase (RLS) or the separate finflow-api backend.
> Code is the source of truth; every doc cites file:line.

## Entry

- [AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): start here — commands, server/client rules, boundaries (audience: agents)
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, quickstart, env setup, doc links
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, scripts, PR checklist

## Architecture

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): request flow, route groups, feature map, key flows, invariants
- [ROUTES.md](docs/ROUTES.md): every path — auth level, rendering mode, loading map, /auth/callback
- [AUTH.md](docs/AUTH.md): three Supabase clients, middleware, OAuth, Turnstile, listener, callback
- [STATE.md](docs/STATE.md): UserContext, LanguageContext, fetch map, persistence map
- [CONVENTIONS.md](docs/CONVENTIONS.md): naming, imports, use-client, data lanes, UX, i18n, forbidden
- [DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md): 8 reverse-engineered ADRs with evidence
- [MIGRATION_NOTES.md](docs/MIGRATION_NOTES.md): monolith → frontend+API split, leftovers, conventions

## Reference

- [CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md): every env var — public?, purpose, default, consumer
- [SECRETS_MAP.md](docs/SECRETS_MAP.md): env exposure levels + rotation paths (names only)
- [SCHEMA.md](docs/SCHEMA.md): the 7 RLS tables this app touches + API-only pointer
- [ANALYTICS.md](docs/ANALYTICS.md): PostHog telemetry vs /analytics feature suite
- [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): Tailwind v4 tokens, shadcn/ui, teal accents
- [DEBT.md](docs/DEBT.md): debt register with severities and fixes

## Workflows

- [DEPLOYMENT.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): Vercel, env groups, verification files, SW versioning, rollback
- [PWA.md](docs/PWA.md): manifest, service worker strategies, push wiring, update flow
- [SEO.md](docs/SEO.md): metadata, sitemap/robots, JSON-LD, canonical host
- [skills/add-page.md](skills/add-page.md): checklist — add a route/page
- [skills/add-component.md](skills/add-component.md): checklist — add a component
- [skills/add-api-call.md](skills/add-api-call.md): checklist — call finflow-api
- [skills/add-translation.md](skills/add-translation.md): checklist — add an i18n string
